name: Bohdan Pavlenko
headline: Application Security Engineer
summary: Application security engineer with a focus on hardening internal tools and reviewing code paths for risk. Known for practical remediation work, careful access control reviews, and clear collaboration with product and engineering teams.

roles.title: Junior Application Security Engineer
bullets: Reviewed application changes in Git and used Rust to investigate risky code paths before release, reducing security issues found late in the cycle by 32%.
Performed Penetration testing across internal services and documented findings with clear reproduction steps for the engineering team.
Tightened IAM configurations for privileged accounts and removed unnecessary access for 18 user groups.
Created repeatable review checklists for source changes and access requests, helping the team close 24 findings faster.

projects.name: Paper Atlas
projects.description: Developed Paper Atlas with Git, IAM and Rust to track controlled content changes and enforce role-based approvals.
